news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 18%
news.body: After last week's 18% share price decline to ₹71.25, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 18.6x. Average trailing P/E is 17x in the Luxury industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 88% over the past three years.

news.title: Now 22% undervalued after recent price drop
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 67% to ₹131. The fair value is estimated to be ₹169, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has been flat over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 10%.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.4% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year (43% increase in shares outstanding). Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (7.4% average weekly change)

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.11 (vs ₹0.54 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.11 (up from ₹0.54 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.27b (up 71% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹45.0m (up 454% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.5% (up from 1.1% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 65% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
